component: About support retired experiment status mapping

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1117 removes the experimentControl and experimentTreatment FissionDecisionStatus names from aboutSupport's mapping. Accepted source maps only the remaining producer statuses and passes the chosen Fluent ID to the status field. Keep the diagnostic mapping aligned with the Gecko snapshot values rather than preserving retired experiment labels indefinitely. This source review does not claim full upstream enumeration coverage or a live about:support result.
title: Remove diagnostic status mappings when the upstream producer drops them
